candidate: NTT DATA Keihanna OSK11 Data Center (京阪奈OSK11データセンター; NTT Global Data Centers planning name （仮称）京阪奈ビル), 京都府相楽郡精華町光台二丁目4番, Seika, Kyoto, Japan
decision: Selected the literal point that GSI (Geospatial Information Authority of Japan) address search returns for the official block address 京都府相楽郡精華町光台二丁目4 (one feature, titled 京都府精華町光台二丁目４番). Kyoto Prefecture's published 特定建築物排出量削減計画書 no. 623 (NTT Global Data Centers Corporation, （仮称）京阪奈ビル, four storeys, 28,915.20 m2) gives that block, 光台二丁目4番, as the location of the building and 72,525.28 m2 as its site, so the point is used as a parent-property marker for the OSK11 site. No geocoding beyond the official address search, no transformation, no offset.
precision_scope: GSI block-level address feature for 光台二丁目4番, the 72,525 m2 lot that Kyoto Prefecture's published plan gives for the OSK11 building. The point falls on the existing NTT Keihanna R&D building (NTT Communication Science Laboratories) in the west of the lot; it is a parent-property marker, not the data-centre building, a data hall, an entrance, a surveyed boundary or the lot outline.
horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: GSI publishes no positional accuracy for block-level address features, and no registry-map (MOJ) geometry exists for 光台 in the 2026 AIGID public-coordinate file for Seika (1,035 lots, only 祝園西, 狛田 and 大字菱田). In undated Esri World Imagery the new building identified as OSK11 lies about 70 to 140 m east of the point (estimated centre about 93 m east).
